what: Letters stuck on top of a section (e.g. WORKS) cross from the left group to the empty slots on the right via Flip as you scroll down the section — starting from the last letter, each .2s later, 1.4s power4.inOut, shrinking to .2× at .8s and returning at .8s while crossing, and in the second half of the section they travel back along the same path (yoyo). Bound to scroll with scrub 3.

options.shrink: Scale multiplier that shrinks while crossing, default .2
options.min: Not applied when narrower than this width (px), default 992
options.[data-fx-part=letter]: Crossing character (the first position is inside the left group)
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: Blanks to move across and sit in — one per letter

note: The scroll range runs from when the top of this part’s parent (the sticky section) touches the top of the screen until the section end reaches the bottom of the screen.

from.where: index.html .works__word (Work section WORKS lettering) · index.js worksWord()
